title: PROP-053 rev2: batched fix for the 6 audit-exp-tracker-gaps.js defects (ISS-2434/2435/2436/2437/2438/2440) flagged by curmudgeon review audit-exp-tracker-gaps.c1
problem_statement:
Curmudgeon's review at monitor/curmudgeon/reviews/audit-exp-tracker-gaps.c1.json (cycle 1, reviewed 2026-06-01T03:10Z, current_verdict_holds=false, confidence 0.95) found 7 defects in the PROP-053 deliverables shipped 2026-05-25. The defects were filed as 6 ISSs on 2026-06-01T05:12-07:16Z (the 7th — minor `--orphans-only` short-circuit — was rolled into the existing ISS-2441 follow-up scope, separately). The 6 ISSs covered by this rev2:

  ISS-2434 [CRITICAL] script: missing archive JSONL read. build-scripts/audit-exp-tracker-gaps.js reads only monitor/analyst/expansion-tracker.json items[] and ignores monitor/analyst/expansion-tracker-archive.jsonl (433 entries, 433 distinct IDs under PROP-022 phase 4). Reports 389 phantom orphan_file entries against live workspace; true orphan count after archive ingestion is 0.
  ISS-2435 [CRITICAL] script: missing no_trace category. PROP-053 spec required four categories (orphan_file, tracker_referenced_no_file, mentioned_only, no_trace); shipped script implements three (ok, orphan_file, tracker_only, mentioned_only). no_trace is the dominant category for true bulk-reservation drift (originally 41 of 94 missing IDs in the 2026-05-24 audit, growing under continued bulk allocation). Without it, integrity has no signal that bulk-reservation drift is occurring at all.
  ISS-2436 [MAJOR] reference doc canonizes the archive-blind bug. monitor/prompts/reference/expansion-tracker-gap-semantics.md says 'Before its introduction, EXPs were written directly to monitor/analyst/expansions/ without tracker entries' and prescribes the heuristic 'EXP-001 through ~EXP-450 = pre-tracker, benign'. There is no pre-tracker era — the archive holds EXP-001 today. The doc invented a historical fiction to rationalize the buggy script output.
  ISS-2437 [MAJOR] output JSON schema mismatch. PROP-053 spec, the shipped script, and the reference doc each describe different output schemas. Spec requires top-level fields { total_slots, present, missing_total, missing_ranges:[{start,end,size}], by_category:{orphan_file, tracker_referenced_no_file, mentioned_only, no_trace}, summary }. Script ships { ok, orphan_file, tracker_only, mentioned_only }. Ref doc speaks in terms of yet a third category set.
  ISS-2438 [MAJOR] PROP-053 implementation_note misdescribes the shipped script. Claims --summary and --json-output flags exist (actual: --json and --orphans-only). Claims 'Includes severity_hint (MODERATE if orphan_file > 5, else INFO)' (grep severity_hint returns zero matches). Claims 'identified 50 orphan_file gaps' (current head produces 389).
  ISS-2440 [MODERATE] structure-integrity.md edit (third PROP-053 deliverable) never shipped. Section 4 of expansion-tracker-gap-semantics.md describes the edit: invoke the audit script and report orphan_file count as MODERATE when >5, INFO otherwise. Integrity currently classifies every detected orphan_file as MAJOR (line 272 of structure-integrity.md), which is the noise pattern PROP-053 was filed to suppress.

The defects are tightly coupled — schema alignment (ISS-2437) touches three files at once. A single batched fix is cleaner than 6 separate fixes. Operator pre-approved this shape via DIRECTIVE-20260602-002.

proposed_fixes.change: Add archive JSONL ingestion. After reading expansion-tracker.json, read expansion-tracker-archive.jsonl line-by-line, parse JSON per line, collect ids into a separate archiveIds Set. Combine into trackedIds = liveIds ∪ archiveIds. Use trackedIds for orphan_file detection (was: liveIds only). Add a new internal category to distinguish 'live-only tracker entry without file' from 'archive-only tracker entry without file' (the latter is the dominant benign case).

Add no_trace classification. After collecting fileIds, trackedIds (live∪archive), and mentionedIds, read tracker.next_id and iterate i from 1 to next_id-1. For each i, if 'EXP-'+i is in NONE of {fileIds, trackedIds, mentionedIds}, classify as no_trace. Also compute missing_total (count where id is not in fileIds AND not in trackedIds) and missing_ranges (consecutive runs of no_trace IDs).

Align output schema to PROP-053 spec. New top-level JSON output fields: total_slots (=next_id-1), present (count of ok+orphan_file+tracker_referenced_no_file), missing_total (count not in fileIds and not in trackedIds), missing_ranges (list of {start,end,size}), by_category (orphan_file, tracker_referenced_no_file, mentioned_only, no_trace), summary (string), severity_hint (MODERATE if orphan_file>5, else INFO). Rename internal category 'tracker_only' to 'tracker_referenced_no_file' to match spec. Update reference doc's category names and triage table to use the new names. The four-category framing replaces the doc's two-sub-type-per-category framing.

Rewrite the doc against the actual architecture: drop the 'pre-tracker era' fiction entirely. State: (a) the tracker has always existed in this project; (b) PROP-022 phase 4 split it into live items[] + archive JSONL; (c) a real orphan_file is a file on disk that is in NEITHER live nor archive, regardless of EXP number; (d) gap density is not evidence of lost work — the no_trace category is the bulk-reservation drift signal. Annotate the rewrite with a short 'errata' paragraph explaining what the doc previously claimed and why that was wrong, per Step 4(b) operator preference.

Rewrite implementation_note to describe what the original 2026-05-25 ship ACTUALLY did (flags --json, --orphans-only; three categories; no severity_hint; 389 orphans reported), then append a paragraph noting that the rev2 implementation (this PROP) ships the spec-conformant behavior. Flip status from 'implemented' to 'superseded-by-rev2' with superseded_at + superseded_by_prop fields. Do NOT add new CLI flags in rev2 per Step 4(d) non-goals.

Add a new sub-bullet to Section 7 (Expansion Tracker Continuity) that integrates the audit-script output. The integrity prompt should: (a) invoke `node build-scripts/audit-exp-tracker-gaps.js --json`, (b) parse the by_category.orphan_file count, (c) report severity as MODERATE when orphan_file > 5, otherwise INFO. Amend the classification line (currently line 272) to note that audit-script orphan_file findings use the MODERATE/INFO scale and do NOT inherit the existing MAJOR classification (which remains for live-archive disjointness violations and next_id collisions). Pure bulk-reservation drift is not a structural integrity issue.

estimated_loc.build-scripts/audit-exp-tracker-gaps.js: ~52 lines added (archive read + no_trace + schema alignment + severity_hint)

operator_pre_approvals_adopted.step_4a_additive_logic: Adopted. The fix is additive (new archiveIds Set + new no_trace classifier loop + new output fields). The existing 3-category logic is preserved as an internal layer; the new output object is constructed alongside the old internal structure rather than restructuring the pipeline.
operator_pre_approvals_adopted.step_4b_doc_rewrite_honest: Adopted. The rewritten ref doc includes a short errata paragraph: 'Earlier versions of this doc described EXP-001 through ~EXP-450 as a pre-tracker era. That framing was incorrect; the tracker has always existed in this project. The doc has been rewritten to match the actual architecture per PROP-053-rev2.'
operator_pre_approvals_adopted.step_4c_schema_canonical_is_spec: Adopted. PROP-053 spec's schema (total_slots/present/missing_total/missing_ranges/missing_in_context/by_category/summary/severity_hint) is the canonical reference. The script and doc are updated to match the spec. Note: spec field 'missing_in_context' is not present in the spec's content_outline; I interpret this as a directive-mention typo for the spec's by_category.no_trace + by_category.mentioned_only union (the 'in-context-but-no-standalone-record' subset). The output emits missing_in_context as an explicit derived field for consumer convenience.
operator_pre_approvals_adopted.step_4d_impl_note_describe_actually: Adopted. New impl_note describes the original 2026-05-25 ship accurately, then the rev2 implementation, with a clear lineage marker.
operator_pre_approvals_adopted.step_4e_integrity_severity_threshold: Adopted. MODERATE when orphan_file > 5, INFO otherwise. The integrity prompt edit invokes the audit script via --json mode and parses the severity_hint field rather than re-implementing the threshold.

non_goals_acknowledged: No change to PROP-053 spec's required output fields (script and doc conform to spec, not vice versa).
No new CLI flags (--summary, --json-output) — impl_note describes existing --json and --orphans-only accurately.
No structure-integrity.md edits beyond shipping the orphan-gap severity reporting.
No re-trigger of an integrity audit run; next daily 02:00 UTC cron picks up the fix naturally.
Original PROP-053 retains its ID; rev-suffix pattern preserves lineage.
verification_pattern: node build-scripts/audit-exp-tracker-gaps.js --json | node -e "const d=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8'));const ok=(d.total_slots>0 && Array.isArray(d.missing_ranges) && d.by_category && Array.isArray(d.by_category.no_trace) && Array.isArray(d.by_category.orphan_file) && Array.isArray(d.by_category.tracker_referenced_no_file) && Array.isArray(d.by_category.mentioned_only) && typeof d.severity_hint==='string' && (d.by_category.orphan_file.length<=5 ? d.severity_hint==='INFO' : d.severity_hint==='MODERATE'));console.log(ok?'FIXED':'STILL_BROKEN');process.exit(ok?0:1);"

post_deployment_canary.expected_orphan_file_count: 60 (was 389 phantom; ~6.5x reduction matches curmudgeon's text_fingerprint.actual_true_orphan_count=60 and over_report_factor=~6.3x). The 60 remaining are GENUINE orphans — suffixed-variant files (e.g., EXP-300-WIN-033-polaris-luminosity-propagate.json) written by the analyst without a tracker entry. These are the real lost-work backfill cohort PROP-053 was originally designed to surface.
post_deployment_canary.expected_no_trace_count_floor: >100 (was unreported; populates with ~117 bulk-reservation drift IDs in 1..560 range, including the 33 pure-phantom IDs from PROP-053's original audit + ~84 additional that accumulated 2026-05-25→2026-06-02)
post_deployment_canary.expected_severity_hint: MODERATE (since orphan_file = 60 > 5). This is the correct emission: 60 real orphans warrant moderate severity, lower than the old MAJOR but not silenced to INFO.
post_deployment_canary.integrity_next_run_expectation: Daily integrity run at 02:00 UTC on 2026-06-03 should emit a MODERATE-tier finding for orphan_file count (was MAJOR pre-rev2). The 60 orphans are a separate routing decision (route to analyst-baby for tracker backfill) — that's downstream of this rev2 ship and not in-scope here.
